nodes.label: Thin Pi Compatibility Model
nodes.rationale: Pi compatibility is deliberately thin: .pi/skills/*/SKILL.md wrappers point at the canonical Claude skill through metadata.canonical_skill, .pi/agents/*.md mirrors point at the canonical Claude role plus its skill, and Pi never redefines domain logic. The source of truth stays .claude/skills/*, .claude/agents/* and src/chec_local_interpreter/*.

nodes.label: Nine-Step Report Workflow
nodes.rationale: Resolve args and preflight, confirm the circuit/date window exactly once, prepare(), fork historical + inference in parallel (they are independent), validate outputs, prepare_expert_alignment(), run expert-alignment (which depends on both validated outputs), render() one local HTML, and only then export/publish as a separate explicit action.

nodes.label: Report Command Family Division of Labour
nodes.rationale: report is the only single-circuit orchestrator; reporte-lote and informe-gerencial invoke it BY REFERENCE (never copying its logic) and reuse the same clustering contract that agrupamiento-circuitos exposes standalone; limpiar-corridas invokes no agent or skill and only maintains the artifacts the other four produce.

nodes.label: Publishing Is Never a Side Effect
nodes.rationale: Generating a local report never publishes. /report and its equivalents only produce local HTML; exporting to the site is a separate deliberate step through web_export, and GitHub Actions deploys Pages only after publishable content is updated. The Astro site is presentation, not project flow — nothing in the pipeline reads it back, which is why its arrow is dotted; the single exception is site/data/variables.json, an optional thematic input to notebook 05 that lives under site/ for historical reasons.

nodes.label: Databricks Deployment Command Tree (Claude-only)
nodes.rationale: Three upload commands plus five /app-* commands publish notebooks as Databricks Apps; all share _contrato-despliegue-databricks.md, have no Pi equivalent, and never touch report_pipeline.py or the LLM roles. Each run leaves a log in reports/despliegues/, and a permissions restriction does not abort the run — it is recorded and the command continues so the report stays complete.

nodes.label: Diagram Lives in the README, Not in a .mmd
nodes.rationale: Loose copies under docs/ fell behind the flow every time it changed, and an out-of-date diagram misleads more than no diagram at all — so the end-to-end Mermaid diagram is kept inline in the README.

nodes.label: KMeans Geometry Decoupled from Notebook 04
nodes.rationale: Until 2026-08-15, notebooks 05 and 06 extracted the KMeans geometry from 04's saved output, tying three notebooks together so a clean checkout could not assign classes. It now lives in data/geometria_kmeans_014_v1.json, versioned in git and reproducible with scripts/exportar_geometria.py; ventanas_015.cargar_clases_criticidad reads it and verifies its sha1 so a centroid change fails loudly instead of drifting silently.

nodes.label: MGCECDL Pipeline Deleted from the Tree
nodes.rationale: On 2026-08-14 the original MGCECDL notebooks were deleted; none were executed or imported, only named by docs. Their living trace is the artifacts they left (the model under data/models/ that notebook 06 and the inference agent still load, and the expert graph under data/graphs/), which can no longer be regenerated from the working tree — recovery is a git checkout of the deleting commit, not archaeology.

nodes.label: chec_tableros Dashboard Modules
nodes.rationale: The five desktop-app dashboards used to live inside a .ipynb each application ran with exec(); since August 2026 they are importable modules under src/chec_tableros/ (clima, agrupamiento, trayectorias_circuitos, trayectorias_vanos, simulador.derivacion and simulador.tablero). notebooks/base_apps/ was emptied and the aplicaciones/_comun/cuaderno.py executor disappeared with it.

nodes.label: Notebook 05 — MIL over vano x ventana bags
nodes.rationale: 05_mil_vano_ventana.ipynb is the project's only remaining notebook and the only one still executed as a notebook: it trains the multiple-instance-learning model whose interpretation the inference role consumes.

nodes.label: vault-circuito Step 9
nodes.rationale: Step 9 of /report projects the circuit's validated narrative JSONs into reports/vault/ and chains an incremental graphify against reports/vault's own graph, never the project-root graph; /informe-gerencial instead renders the vault note directly and does its own isolated full rebuild at step 2.5.

nodes.label: graphify Isolated to reports/vault
nodes.rationale: Every graphify invocation in the report family is scoped to reports/vault — incremental per circuit from /report, full rebuild plus cross-circuit query from /informe-gerencial — and must never touch the project-root graph.

nodes.label: PDF Discussion Table Workflow
nodes.rationale: reports/analysis-documents/ PDFs feed pdf_discussion_pipeline plus the pdf-discussion-extraction role, producing tabla_pdfs_intervalo_*.xlsx with exactly Circuito, Fecha inicio, Fecha fin, Analisis, Evidencia. It must be regenerated whenever PDFs in that folder change.

nodes.label: Required Dataset Columns (CIRCUITO, FECHA, UITI_VANO)
nodes.rationale: DATA_PATH defaults to data/Indicadores_vano_v3.csv resolved from the project root; only CIRCUITO, FECHA and UITI_VANO are required, everything else is optional and recorded as unavailable when missing.
